title: SLO Drift & Mode Splitboard for Model Routes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a single-pane monitoring board that surfaces SLO drift and latency distributions for every model-route, with an explicit breakdown of streaming vs non-streaming (blocking) IO modes. The board should make it fast for SREs and platform engineers to identify whether a drift is caused by increased tails on streaming responses, non-streaming spikes, or by correlated error spikes. Deliverables: Grafana/Looker dashboard definition, queries for metrics store, trace links from slow cohorts, alert rules for SLO drift windows, and a rollout plan for gradual exposure.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows per-model and per-route p50/p95/p99 for streaming and non-streaming with an option to toggle time window (1h/6h/24h)
Each cohort tile includes: token-rate, median response size, concurrency, and error-rate overlay
Trace links available from each bucket (p95/p99) that open in Jaeger/Tempo with relevant span filters
SLO drift alert fires when p95 for any route in production exceeds SLO by >15% for 15 minutes and automatically annotates the board
Queries are efficient (<=2s panel refresh at 1m resolution) and documented for the metrics backend
Rollout plan includes feature-flagged release to internal teams, two-week burn-in, and postmortem criteria
telemetry_queries: Metrics (ClickHouse): SELECT route, model, io_mode, quantile(0.5)(lat_ms) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(lat_ms) AS p95, quantile(0.99)(lat_ms) AS p99 FROM request_latency WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY route, model, io_mode
Streaming split (Prometheus): histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(stream_response_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))
Error overlay (Prometheus): sum(rate(redwood_requests_total{job="inference",status!~"2.."}[5m])) by (route, model, io_mode) / sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[5m])) by (route, model, io_mode)
Trace filter example (Jaeger query): service=redwood-inference AND operation=GenerateToken AND tags.model=MODEL_NAME AND tags.io_mode=streaming AND duration>=P95_MS

Request-shape cohort selector (ClickHouse): SELECT route, model, avg(tokens) AS avg_tokens, avg(concurrency) AS avg_concurrency, quantile(0.95)(lat_ms) FROM request_latency WHERE sequence_length BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY route, model
panels: Top-level summary: global p50/p95/p99 trendlines for streaming vs non-streaming with error-rate stacked area
Model-Route heatstrip: compact grid with routes on rows, models on columns; each cell shows 3 bars (p50/p95/p99) split by color for streaming vs blocking
Drift timeline: per-route p95 ratio to SLO with annotations for deployments, config changes, and autoscaler events
Cohort explorer: interactive selector for request-shape (tokens, prompt size, user-agent) that re-slices the heatstrip
Trace-link panel: for selected cell shows top 5 correlated spans and a link to Jaeger/Tempo with prefilled filters
Error-lag overlay: shows error budget burn rate alongside latency tail changes
Sampling inspector: table of current sampling rates for traces/metrics by route with quick controls to increase sampling for noisy routes
rollout_plan: Phase 1 — Internal alpha: deploy dashboard behind feature flag and enable for SRE and Platform Eng teams only (1 week)
Phase 2 — Expanded beta: enable for 3 high-traffic customer teams; collect performance telemetry and false-positive alerts (2 weeks)
Phase 3 — GA: enable by default for all internal users; create runbook and alerting key results; migrate alerting to SLO team policy (1 week)
Rollback criteria: >3 false positives in a 48h window or panel refresh time >3s at 1m resolution
dependencies: Infra: ClickHouse retention and new indexes for route+model+io_mode
Tracing: ensure Jaeger/Tempo has tag io_mode and model name on spans
